coverage.notes: Official EUB Academic Programmes catalogue, three college pages and University of London recognised teaching-centre page checked 2026-10-19. English undergraduate degree families: Business Administration (four EUB-marketed options), Computer Science (general plus four named specialisms under one degree) and LLB. Six programme records retain four advertised business routes but avoid five duplicate computing degrees. Stand-alone foundation IFP excluded. The 2027 first-year catalogue and separateness of business application choices were not verified, so completeness is false.

institution.summary: Private university teaching University of London degrees in English at its City Campus in Manama, Bahrain.

programmes.name: BSc in Business Administration
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (BSc), University of London
programmes.about: A broad business degree covering management, markets, accounting, operations, human resources and strategy.
programmes.overview: This general route builds a foundation in how organisations operate, make decisions and respond to market conditions. Students study quantitative methods, management and consumption, information systems, and international business and accounting before progressing to strategic and operations management. Later modules address leadership and innovation alongside branding, consumer behaviour and the changing workplace. It prepares students for a range of business functions, entrepreneurship and further study.

programmes.name: BSc in Business Administration with International Business
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (BSc), University of London
programmes.about: Business administration with a focus on international trade, multinational firms, global markets and cross-cultural management.
programmes.overview: Students take the business administration foundation in quantitative methods, management, information systems and accounting, then examine how firms operate across borders. Specialist modules address the global economy and multinational enterprises, emerging markets and Asia-Pacific business, and European business and competition. Teaching draws on Royal Holloway academic direction and includes research-informed business analysis. The route supports progression into international business, trade, consulting and further study.

programmes.name: BSc in Business Administration with Human Resource Management
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (BSc), University of London
programmes.about: Business administration focused on recruitment, organisational performance, workplace change and people management.
programmes.overview: The first undergraduate year covers quantitative business methods, markets, organisational information systems, international business and accounting. The human resources route then investigates staff management, organisational change and performance, and international human resource management. Other modules cover strategy, operations, marketing and how individuals experience globalised work. This combination supports entry-level human resources and organisational development roles as well as further business study.

programmes.name: BSc in Business Administration with Marketing
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (BSc), University of London
programmes.about: Business administration centred on consumer behaviour, marketing research, digital channels, brands and advertising.
programmes.overview: The course begins with quantitative methods, management, markets, information systems and accounting to establish a broad business base. Marketing-focused study then covers marketing research and digital marketing, operations and marketing strategy, consumer behaviour, brand management and advertising. The curriculum also includes organisational leadership and international human resources to place marketing decisions in a wider business context. It prepares students for marketing, advertising, brand and market research functions or further study.

programmes.name: BSc in Computer Science
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science (BSc), University of London
programmes.about: Project-based computer science covering programming, mathematics, software and systems, with four named specialisms.
programmes.overview: This degree starts with programming, computational and discrete mathematics, computer fundamentals, algorithms and web development. Teaching combines technical modules with practical coursework and project work, including a substantial final project. Students may follow the general route or specialise in Data Science, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, Web and Mobile Development, or Games Development. Specialism modules support different technical interests while retaining the core University of London computer science qualification.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (LLB)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), University of London
programmes.about: An English-law undergraduate degree covering legal method, public and private law, with study of EU and Islamic law.
programmes.overview: Students first study legal method, contract law, criminal law and public law, then progress to tort, property, commercial and EU law. Later subjects include jurisprudence and legal theory, company law, equity and trusts, and an introduction to Islamic law. EUB combines the University of London curriculum with opportunities for mooting, debates and visits to legal institutions. The course develops legal analysis and advocacy skills; professional qualification after graduation depends on the rules of the jurisdiction concerned.

faculties.name: College of Business
faculties.guidance: Four advertised BSc Business Administration routes: general, International Business, Human Resource Management and Marketing. An IB Diploma applicant meeting direct-entry requirements studies the three undergraduate years rather than the foundation year.

faculties.name: College of Computing
faculties.guidance: One BSc Computer Science degree with a general route and four named specialisms: Data Science, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, Web and Mobile Development, and Games Development. Specialisms share compulsory computing studies and a final project.

faculties.guidance: The College offers the University of London Bachelor of Laws (LLB), centred on English law with legal skills development and optional Arabic-language Bahrain legal-system seminars.

claims.statement: Bachelor of Laws (LLB): An English-law undergraduate degree covering legal method, public and private law, with study of EU and Islamic law. Students first study legal method, contract law, criminal law and public law, then progress to tort, property, commercial and EU law. Later subjects include jurisprudence and legal theory, company law, equity and trusts, and an introduction to Islamic law. EUB combines the University of London curriculum with opportunities for mooting, debates and visits to legal institutions. The course develops legal analysis and advocacy skills; professional qualification after graduation depends on the rules of the jurisdiction concerned.
